components.css: .ds-ledger-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr; background: #111722; color: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.10); border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow: hidden; } .ds-lead { padding: 18px 22px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.08); } .ds-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-figure-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-figure { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-delta { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #10b981; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-horizon { display: flex; gap: 3px; height: 6px; margin-top: 14px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-horizon span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-cells { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .ds-cell { padding: 18px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border-right: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.08); } .ds-val { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-pos { color: #10b981; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Sleek rounded-lg chip for filtering locations, asset classes, categories, or fiscal periods.
components.css: .ds-pills { display: flex; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } .ds-pill { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.04); color: #94a3b8; border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.10); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-pill:hover { color: #f1f5f9; background: rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.08); } .ds-pill-active { background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; border-color: #6366f1; }

components.name: Form Input Field
components.description: Standard form control with crisp border, Sovereign Indigo focus ring, and icon clearance.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input { height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #0b0f17; border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.14); color: #f1f5f9; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #6366f1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.24); }

narrative.northStar: The Private Bank Consolidated Statement & Family Office Folio
narrative.overview:
Vault is modeled on an institutional Private Bank Consolidated Portfolio Statement & Family Office Folio: an authoritative, ruled fiduciary ledger engineered for rapid scanning, structural clarity, and zero-distraction operation.

Every primary screen opens with a Full-Width Ledger Summary Band (.v-ledger-band) divided by crisp 1px structural hairlines (1px solid var(--v-hairline-subtle)). Inside the Ledger Band, the primary figure (₹ net worth, monthly net spend, FY savings goal, or bullion valuation) commands immediate hierarchy alongside its period delta badge and a Signature Multi-Segment Horizon Bar (.v-horizon) that encodes asset allocation, spend pace vs. prior month, FY goal progress, or custody split in a single glance. Below the band, pages organize into balanced Asymmetric Workbenches (.v-workbench) or Tabbed Ledger Folios, keeping primary tables and feeds dominant while secondary breakdowns, AI methodology notes, and mutation forms live in progressive disclosures, drawers, or side rails.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled Hairline Architecture over Card Soup: Metrics and list items sit inside contiguous, hairline-divided strips (.v-ledger-band, .v-stat-strip, .v-divide-list) rather than separate floating boxes.
Zero-Exception Tabular Numerals: Every rupee figure, Lakh/Crore shorthand, gram weight, percentage, and date enforces font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so vertical columns lock to the pixel.
Signature Horizon Strip: A proportional, color-coded horizontal bar with an inline legend appears inside the top ledger band of every major route to show composition or pacing before scrolling.

Action-Only Primary Saturation: Sovereign Indigo (#6366f1 rings/indicators; #4f46e5 WCAG AA button fill) is reserved strictly for interactive primary actions, active route indicators, and focused controls.
No Eyebrow Kickers or Nested Cards: Section headings speak directly at 1rem (16px) semibold without tiny uppercase kickers above them, and bordered cards never nest inside .v-panel containers.

rules.name: The Action-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Sovereign Indigo marks interactive controls and active states. Never tint large hero backgrounds or static metric numbers in primary indigo; primary figures sit in Primary Ink while semantic delta pills carry Emerald or Rose.

rules.name: The Single-Hairline Rule
rules.body: Adjacent cells in a metric strip or ledger table share a single 1px border (1px solid var(--v-hairline-subtle)). Never place a thick colored border-left or border-right (>1px) on cards, callouts, or list rows.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Never place a small uppercase eyebrow or kicker label above a page headline or section title. Let the title and its inline count or subtitle speak directly.

rules.name: The Tabular Lock Rule
rules.body: Every element displaying currency (₹), percentages (%), weights (g), land units (Gaj, Bigha, Sq.ft), quantities, or dates MUST apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Panels, metric strips, and tables never cast drop shadows at rest and never jump upward (translateY) when hovered unless the entire panel is an anchor link to another route.

dos: Do open primary dashboards and detail pages with a .v-ledger-band (or .v-stat-strip on subpages) pairing the lead figure, delta, and .v-horizon bar.
Do right-align all monetary amounts, percentages, and weights in tables and ledger rows with tabular-nums.
Do group secondary actions (Sync Sheets, Refresh Prices, Export, Biometrics) into a compact toolbar so the primary CTA stands alone.
Do keep 2-column workbenches balanced with zero empty column voids and zero nested card borders.
Do preserve all Django template blocks, URL tags, CSRF tokens, form field names, and JS hooks (openModal, closeModal, confirmDelete, initPagination, Chart.js canvas IDs).
donts: Don't nest bordered cards inside .v-panel or .v-ledger-band; use 1px hairline-divided rows and cells instead.
Don't place small uppercase kicker/eyebrow labels above <h1>, <h2>, or <h3> headings.
Don't use thick colored left borders (border-l-4), gradient text (bg-clip-text), or glowing neon placeholder boxes.
Don't use raw emoji as UI icons; use Material Symbols Outlined or authored inline SVGs everywhere.
